Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a standard bottom-up shotgun proteomics run using DDA (implied by Sequest/Proteome Discoverer and Orbitrap Fusion without DIA mentions) and LFQ. While the paper discusses NETs and FXII activation, the MS proteomics part was a systemic screen of lung tissue without specific PTM enrichment (confirmed by PRIDE metadata 'No PTMs are included in the dataset').

scope: A 100 µm slice per paraformaldehyde fixed lung tissue of Covid-19 infected and control lung tissue was lysed in 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate and 1% w/w sodium deoxycholate buffer boiled at 95 °C for 60 min and sonicated with a probe sonicator to destroy DNA/RNA.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on lysed lung tissue slices. While the paper discusses NETs and FXIIa, the MS material described in the PRIDE sample processing protocol is the total protein extract from the lung tissue slices.
